newsitem.title: UK: European jet jumps sharply, premiums hold steady.
newsitem.headline: European jet jumps sharply, premiums hold steady.

text.p: European jet fuel prices were jolted sharply higher by a rally in underlying futures on Monday, but premiums were steady.
Benchmark IPE gas oil futures leapt $5.00 to trade at $178 a tonne shortly before the close of business.
But premiums were little changed in a thinly talked market. Cargoes were pegged at June IPE +$17-$19 basis Thames. Barges were on offer at June +$18 fob ARA.
"There are some deals which need to get done, but there is a certain amount of reluctance so we're at a bit of a stand-off," a trader said.
The Mediterranean market also got a boost from firmer futures but the region was still long on jet, dealers said.
On the paper market, a June swap traded at June IPE +$20.50.
